candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502. Traces and logs show the gateway's outbound call to order:8000/v1/orders failing with 500 across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db pool, redis, downstream latency) is unproven; only the 500 origin is established.

report.explanation: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 while its client call to order:8000/v1/orders returns 500, so the failure originates in the order service, not the gateway. Order-side telemetry is absent, so the specific order fault is not established; http-500 is the bounded candidate.
